status: exploratory protocol fixed after J results and external reviews, before new K outcome regressions; not preregistration
target: early 2016-2020 asset Delta = beta_up minus beta_down
reference: Delta ~ intercept + log(mean daily nominal BRL volume2015) + log(disclosed capitalization proxy2015) + sector fixed effects
sector_vintage: existing fixed classification, including recovered 2022 archive; not point-in-time 2015 classification
fixed_cases: same J complete-case original80 and union118 panels, expected N62 and N76; main fixed samples80/117 unchanged

inference.statistic: covariance-standardized quadratic radius b' Sigma_boot^-1 b; centered bootstrap radius (b_star-b)' Sigma_boot^-1 (b_star-b), plus-one tail probability; not a fully studentized bootstrap-t
inference.singularity: report non-estimable if covariance rank <2 or condition number >1e12; do not regularize after looking at results
inference.primary_family: Holm2 joint tests across the two overlapping cohorts, separately for each block length; no global FWER across lengths or stages
inference.marginal_intervals: nominal 95% basic bootstrap, raw centered two-sided p descriptive; no separate adjusted individual claims
inference.old_J_family: preserve all eight specifications x two cohorts and Holm16 without changing results
inference.sensitivity_family: Holm6 joint tests: beta2015, exclusion of unmatched-event assets, Amihud2015, each in both cohorts, separately per block; unestimable tests p=1 for family accounting

sensitivities.beta2015: same regime/coverage floors on 2015 valid pairs; beta estimated again under separate 2015 block draws; independent period strata omit cross-boundary covariance
sensitivities.events: exclude entire assets with ANY of the 23 unmatched flags in fixed J ledger2015-2025; retrospective conservative sensitivity, not new primary selection; retain already-masked daily returns
sensitivities.Amihud: replace log volume by log mean(abs(expm1(daily log return2015))/positive nominal daily BRL volume); both return and volume must be observed, no zero-volume substitution; 200 valid pairs and95% of 2015 market sessions; capitalization and sector retained
sensitivities.turnover_reparameterization: log giro=log volume-log capitalization; coefficients(lambda,lambda+gamma); algebraic equivalence checked for fitted values, draws and joint test; not independent robustness
sensitivities.succession_inventory: export observed first/last session, terminal ticker, existing documented alias or unknown status for external2015 assets absent from original80; no inferred delisting or undocumented linkage

calibration.scope: finite conditional simulation of new reference joint tests only; fixed market, masks, X and residual scales; neither fitted DGP validation nor universal coverage guarantee
calibration.deterministic_volatility: 1 first half and2 second half, normalized to unit mean square
calibration.GARCH: omega0.05 alpha0.05 beta0.90, variance starts1, burn500, independent component recursions
calibration.null: lambda=gamma=0, delta_i=0; sector-dependent delta also checked algebraically since annihilated by fixed sector controls
calibration.scales: asset residual RMS from early per-regime intercept/slope fit with original masks; fixed conditional estimates
calibration.outputs: per replication joint p and Holm2 family rejection; mean rejection with Wilson95 intervals and Monte Carlo SE; four nominal marginal CI coverages, retain all six laws
calibration.implementation: exact linear time-weight/grouped-mask acceleration, independently checked against dense weighted OLS; invalid inner draws fail rather than silently omit
calibration.no_retuning: no generator selection, critical-value correction or block choice based on these outputs

input_provenance.daily_matrices: remain external; reuse audited protected I matrix and J turnover, no full quotation download

claims: associations only; joint rejection means at least one coefficient differs, not both positive or causal; no global economic certification
